# Sinyx

Sinyx is a web content infrastructure API for AI workflows.
It converts public web pages into Markdown, plain text, readable HTML, full metadata, and semantic chunks.

## Primary Pages

- Homepage: https://sinyx.me/
- API docs: https://sinyx.me/docs
- Pricing: https://sinyx.me/pricing
- Terms of Service: https://sinyx.me/tos
- Privacy Policy: https://sinyx.me/privacy

## API Access

API keys, subscriptions, usage limits, and billing are managed through RapidAPI:
https://rapidapi.com/ibasitkhan98/api/sinyx/pricing

## Core Endpoints

- POST https://sinyx.p.rapidapi.com/v1/extract
- POST https://sinyx.p.rapidapi.com/v1/extract/batch

## Output Formats

- markdown
- text
- html
- full
- chunks
